changes.title: Stabilize the hero's idle animation at extreme playback speeds
changes.text: At experimental developer speeds above 2x, keep the hero's idle frames at a readable rhythm instead of rapidly flickering. Movement, attacks and other visual effects retain the chosen playback speed. Combat turns and input timing stay unchanged.

changes.title: Verify developer speed isolation and preserve private build history
changes.text: Exercise all ten private speed choices and assert that hero idle animation remains stable while actor and input clocks keep their original timing. Record the owner-reported visual issue and carry forward the preceding complete build history.

commentary: Previous full TEST271 compiled and verified 1779 core, API34 smoke checks and the display matrix. Owner then observed violent idle head flickering at experimental 1000x. This source candidate clamps only hero idle frames to normal delta at private speeds above 2x and adds a regression asserting all ten speeds. Core-only and full APK verification must pass separately. Never infer visual acceptance on a physical phone or publish/distribute an APK automatically.
